install: curl -fsSL -o /tmp/dopamine.deb https://github.com/digimezzo/dopamine/releases/download/v$INGLENOOK_VERSION/Dopamine-$INGLENOOK_VERSION.deb && echo '6a8f611edcf691b4ac730d62db8aba68b3194d1fb2af6bc373f8685e0ac1f231  /tmp/dopamine.deb' | sha256sum -c - && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends /tmp/dopamine.deb ffmpeg sqlite3 jq && rm /tmp/dopamine.deb
apply: jq -n --arg theme "$(jq -r .name "$INGLENOOK_PORT"/dist/$INGLENOOK_VARIANT/*.theme)" --argjson light "$([ "$INGLENOOK_VARIANT" = day ] && echo true || echo false)" '{theme: $theme, followSystemTheme: false, useLightBackgroundTheme: $light, followSystemColor: false, followAlbumCoverColor: false}' > "$HOME/.config/Dopamine/config.json"
stage: c="$HOME/.config/Dopamine/config.json"; jq '. + {showWelcome: false, checkForUpdates: false, downloadMissingAlbumCovers: false, downloadArtistInformationFromLastFm: false, downloadLyricsOnline: false, showIconInNotificationArea: false, showAudioVisualizer: false, fullPlayerPositionSizeMaximized: "200;120;1200;760;0", selectedCollectionPage: 0, artistsTabSelectedArtist: "Wren Calloway"}' "$c" > "$c.new" && mv "$c.new" "$c"
